@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.UaUFJKZxEkN7yraC]{Efecto: Air Elemental Support Beneficio}

Augdunar Support Beneficio.name: Augdunar Support Beneficio
Augdunar Support Beneficio.description: The augdunar shifts its weight, proffering tú an item. Interactuarúas to draw a arma or item that is being carried by the augdunar.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.IcevV2CAx0WlQaLF]{Efecto: Bacallia Support Beneficio}

Until the start of tu next turn, if tú hit and deal daño to a criatura tu badger threatens, el objetivo can't use a Dar un paso action (unless it can Dar un paso through difficult terrain) until it moves from its current position.

Bat Support Beneficio.name: Bat Support Beneficio

Tu bat flaps around tu foes' arms and faces, getting in the way of their attacks. Until the start of tu next turn, criaturas in tu bat's reach that tú daño with Golpes take a –1 penalización de circunstancia to their tiradas de ataque.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.ksT2DrI2r1uZQhz6]{Efecto: Bat Support Beneficio}

Bear Support Beneficio.name: Bear Support Beneficio

Tu bear mauls tu enemies when tú create an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura in the bear's reach with a Golpe, the criatura takes @Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño from the bear. If tu bear is nimble or savage, the daño cortante increases to [[/r 2d8]].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.zAvLdUNaJrKOMfQY]{Efecto: Bear Support Beneficio}

Beetle Support Beneficio.name: Beetle Support Beneficio

Tu beetle stomps around and smashes into foes, knocking them off balance or pushing them aside when tú create an opening. @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.Jvh1ciiT9JWXILxo]{Efecto: Beetle Support Beneficio}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.s2tD44BtYMJpEXjO]{Efecto: Bird Support Beneficio}

Chetamog Support Beneficio.name: Chetamog Support Beneficio
Chetamog Support Beneficio.description: Un chetamog ignora el terreno dificil y el terreno dificil mayor causado por follaje no magico.

Combat Squox Support Beneficio.name: Combat Squox Support Beneficio
Combat Squox Support Beneficio.description: Tu squox works with tú to form an opening in combat. Until the start of tu next turn, if tu Golpe damages a criatura in tu squox's reach, tu squox can attempt to [[/act disarm]] el objetivo using its Acrobatics instead of Athletics.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.33LFnwNIIHChfZz8]{Efecto: Cragstone Bear Support Beneficio}

Crocodile Support Beneficio.name: Crocodile Support Beneficio

Tu crocodile clamps its jaws on tu foe, refusing to let go. Until the start of tu next turn, if tu Golpe damages a criatura in tu crocodile's reach, tu crocodile can latch onto the criatura. Tu crocodile can latch onto only one criatura in this way, and it must release the criatura to make a jaws Golpe. If el objetivo is smaller than the crocodile, it takes a –10-pies penalización de circunstancia to its Velocidades and can't Fly while the crocodile is latched on.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.FnJH9CPDngavuhwc]{Efecto: Crocodile Support Beneficio}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.xrdIXhRDUHgC8wAe]{Efecto: Draft Lizard Support Beneficio}

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.yTWDjFno6nKETfXY]{Efecto: Elephant Support Beneficio}

Ravenous Drake Support Beneficio.name: Ravenous Drake Support Beneficio
Ravenous Drake Support Beneficio.description:
Tu ravenous drake constantly tries to pull tu foe or their possessions into its waiting jaws. Obtienes a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to any Athletics check to [[/act disarm]], [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] an opponent adjacent to tu ravenous drake.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.vZarTalIYKxQ0Pgr]{Efecto: Ravenous Drake Support Beneficio}

Rhinoceros Support Beneficio.name: Rhinoceros Support Beneficio
Rhinoceros Support Beneficio.description:
Tu rhino swings its heavy head to unbalance tu enemigo. The first criatura within tu rhino's reach that tú hit and deal daño to before the start of tu next turn becomes @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Clumsy]{Clumsy 1} until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.LqhSjyZbMN1wKPss]{Efecto: Rhinoceros Support Beneficio}

Riding Dragonet Support Beneficio.name: Riding Dragonet Support Beneficio
Riding Dragonet Support Beneficio.description:
Tu dragonet's wings flutter rapidly, pulsating the air around tú both. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú Golpe while riding the dragonet and hit a criatura in the dragonet's reach, the criatura takes 1d4 daño contundente from the force of the dragonet's wings. If tu dragonet is nimble or savage, the daño contundente increases to 2d4.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.W0umjrZCgfSo0qh6]{Efecto: Riding Dragonet Support Beneficio}

Riding Drake Support Beneficio.name: Riding Drake Support Beneficio
Riding Drake Support Beneficio.description:
Tu drake snorts fire in tu foes' faces. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú Golpe while riding the drake and hit a criatura in the drake's reach, the criatura takes @Damage[1d4[fire]] daño from the drake. If tu drake is nimble or savage, the daño de fuego increases to @Damage[2d4[fire]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.5VHKIMzKMw3r2BOa]{Efecto: Riding Drake Support Beneficio}

Riding Tarantula Support Beneficio.name: Riding Tarantula Support Beneficio
Riding Tarantula Support Beneficio.description:
Tu riding tarantula flicks urticating hairs at tu foe, disrupting their focus. Until the start of tu next turn, if tú hit and deal daño to a criatura tu riding tarantula threatens, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[type:flat|dc:5] siempre que it takes a concentrate action or that action is lost.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.faBOi3CkoeQtQ0Dc]{Efecto: Riding Tarantula Support Beneficio}

Roc Support Beneficio.name: Roc Support Beneficio
Roc Support Beneficio.description:
Tu roc beats its wings, creating a powerful downdraft. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño a criatura that tu roc threatens push el objetivo 5 pies away from tu roc.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.5AeK9y6jDQrFMYv3]{Efecto: Roc Support Beneficio}

Rootball Chair Support Beneficio.name: Rootball Chair Support Beneficio
Rootball Chair Support Beneficio.description: Tu rootball chair moves smoothly over most terrain, thanks to its many tendrils. Tu rootball chair ignores difficult terrain.

Salamander Support Beneficio.name: Salamander Support Beneficio
Salamander Support Beneficio.description: Tu salamander secretes a poisonous, viscous fluid from its skin. Until the start of tu next turn, if tú or tu salamander are hit by a criatura adjacent to the salamander, that criatura takes @Damage[1d6[poison]] daño. Este daño increases to @Damage[2d6[poison]|shortLabel] if the salamander is nimble or savage.

Scorpion Support Beneficio.name: Scorpion Support Beneficio
Scorpion Support Beneficio.description:
Tu scorpion drips poison from its stinger when tú create an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño a criatura in tu scorpion's reach also deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño. If tu scorpion is nimble or savage, the daño persistente de veneno increases to @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.YNclyD1YN0eGiOix]{Efecto: Scorpion Support Beneficio}

Severed Head Support Beneficio.name: Severed Head Support Beneficio
Severed Head Support Beneficio.description:
The head latches on to tu enemigo with its jaws when tú create an opening, distracting them and hampering their movement. The next criatura within range of tu severed head that tú successfully Golpe before the start of tu next turn takes a –5-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades and must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:5] to use reactions triggered by tu actions until the start of tu next turn. On a failure, the reaction is lost.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.IReZWo5PdAe4F9IH]{Efecto: Severed Head Support Beneficio}

Shadow Hound Support Beneficio.name: Shadow Hound Support Beneficio
Shadow Hound Support Beneficio.description:
Tu shadow hound shrouds tu foes in shadow when tú leave an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, when tú daño a criatura with a Golpe and that criatura is within reach of tu shadow hound, both tú and tu shadow hound become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} to the criatura until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.Go7Tbyf3vpAW6rFs]{Efecto: Shadow Hound Support Beneficio}

Shark Support Beneficio.name: Shark Support Beneficio
Shark Support Beneficio.description:
When tu shark senses blood, it tears into tu enemies. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura in the shark's reach with a Golpe and deal slashing or daño perforante, the criatura takes @Damage[1d8[slashing]] daño from the shark. If tu shark is nimble or savage, the daño cortante increases to @Damage[2d8[slashing]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.Lgc3OAVIdK8uN9nM]{Efecto: Shark Support Beneficio}

Shotalashu Support Beneficio.name: Shotalashu Support Beneficio
Shotalashu Support Beneficio.description:
The shotalashu telepathically assails tu enemies when tú create an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura in the shotalashu's reach with a Golpe, the criatura takes @Damage[1d6[mental]] daño from the shotalashu. If tu shotalashu is nimble or savage, the daño mental increases to @Damage[2d6[mental]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.TNnBontVMih3LYaC]{Efecto: Shotalashu Support Beneficio}

Skeletal Bird of Prey Support Beneficio.name: Skeletal Bird of Prey Support Beneficio
Skeletal Bird of Prey Support Beneficio.description:
The bird flaps around and throws tu foe off balance. Until the start of tu next turn, when tú daño a criatura in the bird's reach with a Golpe, that criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.tyTTl3B8OWtWYhcX]{Efecto: Skeletal Bird of Prey Support Beneficio}

Skeletal Constrictor Support Beneficio.name: Skeletal Constrictor Support Beneficio
Skeletal Constrictor Support Beneficio.description:
Tu snake sways, captivating an enemigo. Elige one criatura within 20 pies of the constrictor that can see it. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that deal daño to the chosen criatura make el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.tBLkLrtoRFbYV1f4]{Efecto: Skeletal Constrictor Support Beneficio}

Skeletal Mount Support Beneficio.name: Beneficio por apoyo de montura esquelética
Skeletal Mount Support Beneficio.description:
Tu montura esquelética causa miedo cuando carga. Hasta el inicio de tu siguiente turno, si estás montando sobre ella y mueves al menos 10 pies (3 m) en la acción antes de atacar, cualquier criatura dañada por el ataque queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustada 1}, o @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Asustada 2} si el ataque fue un golpe crítico. Esto es un efecto de emoción, mental y miedo

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.VVpMpJB3hdTNYdNV]{Efecto: Beneficio por apoyo de montura esquelética}

Skeletal Servant Support Beneficio.name: Beneficio de apoyo de sirviente esquelético
Skeletal Servant Support Beneficio.description:
Tu sirviente esquelético clava huesos en tus enemigos para distraerlos mientras los atacas. Hasta el inicio de tu siguiente turno, cuando des un Golpe que cause daño a una criatura dentro del alcance de tu sirviente esquelético, ese objetivo queda @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} hasta el final de tu siguiente turno.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.GQFr15dRbQyfsiTF]{Efecto: Beneficio de apoyo de sirviente esquelético}

Snake Support Beneficio.name: Snake Support Beneficio
Snake Support Beneficio.description: Tu snake holds tu enemies with its coils, interfering with reactions. Until the start of tu next turn, any criatura tu snake threatens can't use reactions triggered by tu actions unless its level is higher than yours.

Sundaflora Support Beneficio.name: Sundaflora Support Beneficio
Sundaflora Support Beneficio.description:
Tu sundaflora inspires tu allies with its calm demeanor and agile steps. Elige one ally within 30 pies of tu sundaflora. They gain a +1 bonificador de circunstancia to their next tirada de ataque to Golpe a foe within tu sundaflora's reach. The bonus lasts until the first time tu ally uses it or until the beginning of tu next turn, whichever comes first.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.I89IDoLnz4RnfYtX]{Efecto: Sundaflora Support Beneficio}

Terror Bird Support Beneficio.name: Terror Bird Support Beneficio
Terror Bird Support Beneficio.description:
Tu terror bird screeches at tu enemies when tú create an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that deal daño to a criatura within tu terror bird's reach make el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Desprevenido} until the start of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.Vbi6XlP86bndpHs1]{Efecto: Terror Bird Support Beneficio}

Tikar Urchinpad Support Beneficio.name: Tikar Urchinpad Support Beneficio
Tikar Urchinpad Support Beneficio.description:
Tu tikar urchinpad attempts to wrap its tendrils around tu foe's limbs, pulling it off balance. Until the end of tu next turn, as long as estás adjacent to tu urchinpad, if tú attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip} an opponent and roll a critical failure, tú get a failure instead.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.ciyeCV7RsTtFcYKw]{Efecto: Tikar Urchinpad Support Beneficio}

Triceratops Support Beneficio.name: Triceratops Support Beneficio
Triceratops Support Beneficio.description:
Tu triceratops gores @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} targets in tu wake. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño a prone criatura in tu triceratops's reach also deal @Damage[1d8[persistent,bleed]] daño. If tu triceratops is nimble or savage, the daño persistente de sangrado increases to @Damage[2d8[persistent,bleed]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.VK0u5yF0dO2YlGra]{Efecto: Triceratops Support Beneficio}

Tyrannosaurus Support Beneficio.name: Tyrannosaurus Support Beneficio
Tyrannosaurus Support Beneficio.description:
Tu tyrannosaurus roars and puts on a fearsome display as tú attack, startling tu foes. Until the start of tu next turn, if tú hit and deal daño to a criatura within tu tyrannosaurus's reach, the criatura is @Compendium[pf2e.conditionitems.Asustado]{Asustado 1}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.UJYz572LoOw3LH8u]{Efecto: Tyrannosaurus Support Beneficio}

Ulgrem-Lurann Support Beneficio.name: Ulgrem-Lurann Support Beneficio
Ulgrem-Lurann Support Beneficio.description:
The Ulgrem-Lurann grabs at tu foe and zaps it. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura in the Ulgrem-Lurann's reach with a Golpe, the criatura takes an additional @Damage[1d4[piercing],1d4[electricity]] daño from the Ulgrem-Lurann. If the Ulgrem-Lurann is nimble or savage, the daño perforante and daño de electricidad each increase to @Damage[2d4[piercing],2d4[electricity]]{2d4}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.axG8U0tIGTXhjA6x]{Efecto: Ulgrem-Lurann Support Beneficio}

Umbrella Mushroom Support Beneficio.name: Umbrella Mushroom Support Beneficio
Umbrella Mushroom Support Beneficio.description:
Tu umbrella mushroom exudes sense dulling spores when tú create an opening. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño a criatura within tu umbrella mushroom's reach becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 round. Este effect has the poison rasgo.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.RjwPBh2CCTUJAa3e]{Efecto: Umbrella Mushroom Support Beneficio}

Undead Hand Support Beneficio.name: Undead Hand Support Beneficio
Undead Hand Support Beneficio.description:
The hand viciously batters the foes tú attack. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura in the hand's reach with a Golpe, the criatura takes @Damage[1d6[bludgeoning]] daño from the hand. If tu hand is nimble or savage, the daño contundente increases to @Damage[2d6[bludgeoning]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.TbsMurFpA6ZkZIfF]{Efecto: Undead Hand Support Beneficio}

Vampiric Animal Support Beneficio.name: Beneficio por apoyo de Animal vampírico
Vampiric Animal Support Beneficio.description:
Cuando tu animal vampírico huele sangre se lanza contra tus enemigos. Hasta el inicio de tu siguiente turno, tus Golpes que dañen a una criatura dentro del alcance del animal vampírico también causan @Damage[1d6[persistent,bleed]]{1d6 persistente por sangrado}. Si tu animal vampírico es ágil o salvaje, el daño persistente es @Damage[2d6[persistent,bleed]|shortLabel]{2d6}.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.rtIhCBYVeEywrZOf]{Efecto: Beneficio por apoyo de Animal vampírico}

Vulture Support Beneficio.name: Vulture Support Beneficio
Vulture Support Beneficio.description: The vulture retches and vomits onto a foe within 10 pies. Until the start of tu next turn, if tú hit and deal daño to el objetivo, el objetivo must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|against:vulture-support] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 2} on a critical failure). The DC of the Fortitude save is 12 (or 14, if the vulture is a specialized animal companion) + tu level + the vulture's Constitution modifier.

War Pig Support Beneficio.name: War Pig Support Beneficio
War Pig Support Beneficio.description:
Tu war pig bodychecks tu enemies, leaving them numb from the impact. Until the start of tu next turn, Golpes tú make that deal daño to a criatura within tu war pig's reach make el objetivo @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.EutUqr7s9d9bRy9b]{Efecto: War Pig Support Beneficio}

Water Elemental Support Beneficio.name: Water Elemental Support Beneficio
Water Elemental Support Beneficio.description:
Tu water elemental waterlogs a foe. The first time before the start of tu next turn tú hit with a Golpe that deals daño to a criatura within tu water elemental's reach, that criatura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the end of tu next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.DB0mJPinz35BgBS1]{Efecto: Water Elemental Support Beneficio}

Water Wraith Support Beneficio.name: Water Wraith Support Beneficio
Water Wraith Support Beneficio.description:
Tu water wraith hisses and changes colors swiftly in an iridescent clash, overwhelming tu foes in an avalanche of shades and hues. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura within tu water wraith's reach, the criatura is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.7WtmY88CPY7lxW3q]{Efecto: Water Wraith Support Beneficio}

Wolf Support Beneficio.name: Wolf Support Beneficio
Wolf Support Beneficio.description:
Tu wolf tears tendons with each opening. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño criaturas tu wolf threatens give el objetivo a –5-pies penalización de estado to its Velocidades for 1 minute (–10 on a critical success).

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.zDFmtmfZfAvIVF93]{Efecto: Wolf Support Beneficio}

Wood Elemental Support Beneficio.name: Wood Elemental Support Beneficio
Wood Elemental Support Beneficio.description:
Tu wood elemental entangles tu foes with detachable branches and roots. Until the start of tu next turn, if tú hit with a Golpe that deals daño to a criatura in tu wood elemental's reach, the criatura takes a –5-pies penalización de circunstancia to its Velocidades for 1 minute (–10 on a critical success). The criatura, or a criatura adjacent to it, can use an Interactuar action to unravel the branches and roots and remove the penalización.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.yw1K63aPTWRj76Nn]{Efecto: Wood Elemental Support Beneficio}

Wyvern Support Beneficio.name: Wyvern Support Beneficio
Wyvern Support Beneficio.description:
Tu wyvern whips its stinger at tu foes. Until the start of tu next turn, tu Golpes that daño a criatura in tu wyvern's reach also deal @Damage[1d6[persistent,poison]] daño. If tu wyvern is nimble or savage, the daño persistente increases to @Damage[2d6[persistent,poison]|shortLabel].

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.7dCJv3nCv85lwFO7]{Efecto: Wyvern Support Beneficio}

Yzobu Support Beneficio.name: Yzobu Support Beneficio
Yzobu Support Beneficio.description: The next criatura to make a melee attack against the yzobu or its rider before the start of tu next turn is overwhelmed by the criatura's terrible stench and must attempt a @Check[fortitude] save. Este DC is equal to tu class DC or conjuro DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, the attacker takes a –2 penalización de circunstancia to its tirada de ataque. Este ability has the olfactory rasgo.

Zombie Carrion Bird Support Beneficio.name: Zombie Carrion Bird Support Beneficio
Zombie Carrion Bird Support Beneficio.description:
The zombie emits an aura of rot, causing wounds to fester. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit and deal daño to a criatura that's within 10 pies of the zombie carrion bird, the criatura takes an additional @Damage[1d6[untyped]] daño as the wound festers. If tu carrion bird is nimble or savage, the daño increases to @Damage[2d6[untyped]]. Este is a disease and necromancy effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.FoDGPqWjs8QRR3qv]{Efecto: Zombie Carrion Bird Support Beneficio}

Zombie Mount Support Beneficio.name: Zombie Mount Support Beneficio
Zombie Mount Support Beneficio.description:
Tu zombie mount chews on tu enemies. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú Golpe while riding the zombie mount and hit a criatura in the zombie mount's reach, the criatura takes @Damage[1d4[bludgeoning]] daño from the zombie mount. If tu zombie mount is nimble or savage, the daño contundente increases to @Damage[2d4[bludgeoning]|shortLabel]. Este benefit is based on a zombie horse or camel, but might deal daño perforante if tu mount has sharp teeth.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.3sRHNnPMUY2f4SF3]{Efecto: Zombie Mount Support Beneficio}

Zombie Support Beneficio.name: Zombie Support Beneficio
Zombie Support Beneficio.description:
The zombie emits an aura of rot, causing wounds to fester. Until the start of tu next turn, each time tú hit a criatura that's within 10 pies of the zombie and tú deal daño, the criatura takes an additional @Damage[1d6[untyped]] daño as the wound festers. If tu zombie is nimble or savage, the daño increases to @Damage[2d6[untyped]|shortLabel]. Este is a disease and necromancy effect.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-animal-companions.AC-effects.Item.vtArjXfpSGTKbmL9]{Efecto: Zombie Support Beneficio}
